headline: EA shuts down BioWare, cancels next Mass Effect game
summary: Electronic Arts is closing BioWare, the studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age, after more than 30 years, canceling the next Mass Effect game that was in early development and cutting about 400 jobs. A trailer apparently depicting the canceled project later leaked online.

claims.statement: The closure also includes BioWare's Edmonton studio.
The shutdown comes with EA's parent company laying off about 400 employees.
A trailer apparently depicting the canceled Mass Effect game leaked online after the shutdown.
